title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1996 17.10.3 There has been a significant fall (23.7%) in the number of cases of thefts of cultural properties in 1996 over 1995. During 1996, 2,870 such cases were registered where-in, the property lost was to the tune of Rs.648.8 lakhs. Of the recoveries made in the theft cases of cultural properties, hardly in 30 percent cases, recoveries could be made during this year.
